title: backlog.py drop, move and reopen write item files with no --commit, so the main checkout stays dirty until the files are committed by hand
goal: drop, move and reopen take --commit and --trailer 'KEY: VALUE' as new and set do, committing only the item files the command wrote with the fixed subject and a KB-Work trailer naming the items, so land and sync find a clean checkout

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    def g(*a):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    def bl(*a):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    g("init", "-q"); g("config", "user.email", "x@example.com"); g("config", "user.name", "x")
    open(os.path.join(d, "README"), "w").write("x\n"); g("add", "."); g("commit", "-qm", "init")
    sp = bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "S", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    one = bl("new", "story", "--title", "One", "--goal", "g", "--sprint", sp, "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    two = bl("new", "story", "--title", "Two", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    assert not g("status", "--porcelain").stdout.strip(), "the planted clone is not clean before the commands"
    moved = bl("move", one, "--sprint", "none", "--commit")
    assert moved.returncode == 0 and not g("status", "--porcelain").stdout.strip(), ("move --commit", moved.returncode, (moved.stdout + moved.stderr)[-160:])
    dropped = bl("drop", two, "--why", "planted", "--commit")
    assert dropped.returncode == 0 and not g("status", "--porcelain").stdout.strip(), ("drop --commit", dropped.returncode, (dropped.stdout + dropped.stderr)[-160:])

import glob, json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    def g(*a):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    def bl(*a):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    g("init", "-q"); g("config", "user.email", "x@example.com"); g("config", "user.name", "x")
    open(os.path.join(d, "README"), "w").write("x\n"); g("add", "."); g("commit", "-qm", "init")
    t = "Co-Authored-By: Planted <planted@example.com>"
    one = bl("new", "story", "--title", "One", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    two = bl("new", "story", "--title", "Two", "--goal", "g", "--commit").stdout.split()[2]
    path = glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "**", one + ".json"), recursive=True)[0]
    item = json.load(open(path)); item["status"] = "done"; item["evidence"] = {"commit": "0" * 40, "checks": []}
    json.dump(item, open(path, "w"), indent=2); g("add", "."); g("commit", "-qm", "done one")
    assert not g("status", "--porcelain").stdout.strip(), "planted clone is not clean"
    bad = []
    for name, args, iid in (("reopen", ("reopen", one, "--why", "planted"), one), ("drop", ("drop", two, "--why", "planted"), two)):
        r = bl(*args, "--commit", "--trailer", t)
        body = g("log", "-1", "--format=%B").stdout
        ok = r.returncode == 0 and not g("status", "--porcelain").stdout.strip() and "KB-Work: " + iid in body and t in body
        if not ok:
            bad.append((name, r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-80:]))
    print(bad)
    sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
